title: BERTilda: Explainable Topic Lifecycle Tracking with Split/Merge Detection via Similarity-and-Flow Temporal Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2608.18101v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Longitudinal text streams exhibit topic birth and death, but also discrete structural reorganizations in which themes split into subtopics or merge into broader narratives. Many dynamic topic models emphasize smooth drift, while snapshot topic models (fit independently per time window) leave temporal correspondence underspecified. We present BERTilda, an explainable framework that discovers topics independently in each window (using an embedding-based topic model) and then constructs a temporal topic graph linking topics across adjacent windows. Links are supported by two complementary signals: (i) semantic similarity between topic representations and (ii) a bidirectional coverage signal that estimates document outflow (where a topic goes) and inflow (where a topic comes from) via cross-window tweet-to-topic attribution. Graph-based rules label continuations, splits, merges, disappearances, and unclear transitions. We evaluate BERTilda o

translated_title: BERTilda：基于相似性与流时间图的可解释主题生命周期跟踪及分裂/合并检测
translated_abstract: 纵向文本流表现出主题的诞生与消亡，同时也存在离散的结构重组，其中主题会分裂为子主题或合并为更广泛的叙事。许多动态主题模型侧重于平滑演变，而快照主题模型（每个时间窗口独立拟合）则对时间对应关系描述不足。我们提出了BERTilda，一个可解释的框架，它在每个窗口中独立发现主题（使用基于嵌入的主题模型），然后构建一个连接相邻窗口主题的时间主题图。链接由两个互补信号支持：（i）主题表示之间的语义相似性，以及（ii）一个双向覆盖信号，通过跨窗口推文到主题的归属来估计文档流出（主题去向）和流入（主题来源）。基于图的规则标记延续、分裂、合并、消失和模糊过渡。我们在BERTilda上进行了评估。
tldr: BERTilda通过结合语义相似性和双向覆盖信号构建时间主题图，实现了对主题生命周期中分裂与合并事件的可解释检测。
en_tdlr: BERTilda enables explainable detection of topic splits and merges by constructing temporal topic graphs with semantic similarity and bidirectional coverage signals.
